headline: Data Platform & AI Architect | Healthcare, PBM & Regulated Industries | Canonical Data Models | AWS, Azure, GCP | Grower of Teams & Servant-Leader
summary: I’m passionate about bringing data to life for clients. I build cloud-native data platforms for healthcare, regulated, and enterprise environments — and the teams that can own them after I leave. For over 20 years, I've led the design of event-driven, configuration-driven platforms across AWS, Azure, and GCP, using canonical data models and reusable ingestion patterns to turn complex source landscapes — SAP, Oracle Fusion, Salesforce, legacy systems — into trusted Data Products. Deep expertise in healthcare data (PBM, claims processing, eligibility, HIPAA) and financial services, with a consistent focus on governed data products that only put trusted data in front of consumers. I've built and scaled consulting practices from zero three times — $4.5M at SPR, $3M at NVISIA, $2M at PSC — tripling headcount while maintaining profitability. Across those practices and 20+ years of client delivery, I've directly coached 40+ professionals into senior roles: junior engineers into client-facing consultants, mid-level engineers into senior architects, individual contributors into engagement leads. The philosophy is simple — show by doing, then teach them to fish. The proof: on the engagements I've led, client teams don't just receive a platform; they leave capable of owning and extending it themselves. Unified architecture is non-negotiable. Whether extending a platform across hyperscalers, integrating heterogeneous ERP and CRM systems, or aligning engineering, product, and business leadership around a shared data vocabulary — the goal is always one coherent platform, not fragmented implementations. That architectural journey led me to build a production-grade AI system from the ground up: multi-agent orchestration, knowledge graph grounding, local GPU inference with cloud fallback, and a quality assurance harness that scores every AI output before it reaches production. The same governance principles I apply to enterprise data platforms — trusted outputs, shared vocabulary, configuration-driven design — now govern how I architect AI systems. Core capabilities: • Cloud-native data platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP) • Agentic AI architecture and multi-agent orchestration • Healthcare data (PBM, claims, eligibility, HIPAA) • Canonical data model design and operationalization • Knowledge graph design and AI quality governance • Event-driven / configuration-driven architecture • Talent development, team growth, and client enablement

current_job.title: Independent AI Architecture & Research
current_job.description:
Designing and building a multi-component AI architecture that applies agentic AI, knowledge graph grounding, and local GPU inference to enterprise workflow automation — an intentional evolution from data platform architecture into AI-native system design.

KEY CONTRIBUTIONS:
• Architected multi-agent orchestration system with specialized AI agents — architect, tester, security engineer, editor — each with defined responsibilities, background job management, audit trails, and quality-scored handoffs between agents
• Designed quality assurance harness that scores every AI-generated output on faithfulness, truthfulness, accuracy, and latency — governance-first approach where AI outputs require proof before reaching production
• Built knowledge graph architecture fusing structured domain data with vector-based semantic search (RAG), enabling cross-domain context enrichment that breaks data silos across projects, technologies, and organizational knowledge
• Implemented cost-optimized inference architecture: local GPU as primary (30B parameter models), cloud AI as governed fallback — reducing inference costs to near-zero while maintaining quality gates
• Designed flow orchestration engine with YAML-defined step DAGs, context persistence, and multi-model routing — enabling complex multi-step AI workflows with deterministic governance
• Applied agentic governance patterns — architectural rules as code, indexed in semantic search, enforced via automation

Integrating agentic AI and intelligent orchestration into platform architecture alongside canonical data models and event-driven design.

KEY CONTRIBUTIONS:
• Architected healthcare data platforms using canonical data models that abstract source system complexity into trusted, domain-based data products serving clinical and operational consumers
• Designed agentic AI components into the platform architecture — automated data quality validation, intelligent ingestion orchestration, and compliance monitoring as first-class architectural services rather than bolt-on tooling
• Introduced shared decomposition vocabulary — canonical data models, core data products, use-case data products, producers, consumers, consumables — that unified cross-functional teams of engineers, architects, product owners, and data/business/IT leaders around a common framework
• Designed configuration-driven, DSL-based ingestion architecture enabling rapid onboarding of new healthcare data sources without custom ETL code
• Coached data engineers on design thinking and architectural trade-offs, transitioning team from ad-hoc problem solving to repeatable, consistent work products
• Operationalized platforms with client teams for independent ownership and extension to new use cases post-engagement
